title: Gas Mileage and Claim Mileage Mentions
summary: This topic combines clear praise for fuel economy with many administrative or informational mileage mentions that do not express a definite opinion.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle's gas or fuel mileage as very good, excellent, or pleasing.

negative.summary: The negative review expresses dissatisfaction with the mileage being achieved.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly record claim-mileage entries or mention mileage expectations and display issues without a clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: The topic mixes customer opinions about fuel economy with administrative 'Claim Mileage' records, which limits thematic coherence.
Many sampled fragments are undetermined, so the examples provide limited detail about why mileage is mentioned in those cases.
The sampled fragments are stratified and not representative of all reviews for estimating broader customer experience.
